expectations.text: Cites the US interagency proposal (91 FR 58536, September 15, 2026) with comments due November 16, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Proposed Third-Party Risk Management Guidance... published September 15, 2026 (91 FR 58536)... Comments are due November 16, 2026"

expectations.text: Cites CBI CP173 (October 8, 2026, closing December 3, 2026) and its cross-industry, outcomes-based scope
expectations.evidence: "CP173 on October 8, 2026. The consultation closes December 3, 2026. It would replace the December 2021 Cross-Industry Guidance on Outsourcing with an outcomes-based approach to third-party risks"

expectations.text: Mentions the EBA's September 2026 final guidelines extending third-party risk coverage to non-ICT services
expectations.evidence: "It follows the EBA's September 2026 final guidelines on third-party risk for non-ICT services. That widens the lens beyond ICT"

expectations.text: References the DORA CTPP regime (19 providers designated November 2025) as the EU concentration-risk mechanism
expectations.evidence: "The first CTPP list was published November 18, 2025... Concentration on a designated provider is now explicit and visible to supervisors" - count of 19 not given but regime, date and concentration role stated

expectations.text: Recommends mapping subcontractor chains and concentration exposure as a practical step
expectations.evidence: "Map beyond the first tier... obtain a sub-processor and fourth-party list" and "Find the shared dependencies... the real concentration points"
